findings.text: blocking: the default axis-facing cut is only half of the fitted Bell region when its stationary level connects both lobes, while the connected mode jumps at contact and fails all three map guards, so neither mode supplies the requested exact, continuous owner and three converged cold solves.

blocking: the outer conic coordinate is evaluated by adaptive or 256-node numerical quadrature, so the delivered algorithm does not implement the closed-form conic-arc Green integral required by the plan.

blocking: require_map refuses the fine axis-facing map and every connected Bell map before correction, leaving the 2,098-cell cold root and its continuity, limited, sweep, transition and converged-batch controls unmeasured.

follow-on: this map duplicates fast_map_production/program.py:150 rather than extending it, and containing_owner_map.py:63 and projected_owner_map.py:59 copy the same capability again, leaving competing map owners to reconcile.

follow-on: both sides come from the same integrator with different component flags, so a shared zero or scale regression can preserve the two-to-one relation without verifying the positive-level physical region.

follow-on: the adaptive and dense modes share slice_integral and the fitted conic selector, so their agreement checks outer quadrature but cannot detect a shared wrong physical region or restored half-plane handoff.
